exposure: Use of Monoglyde® poliglecaprone-25 suture for subcuticular skin closure
Use of Monocryl® poliglecaprone-25 suture for subcuticular skin closure
outcome: Incidence of wound composite outcomes (surgical site infection [SSI], wound dehiscence, seroma, or hematoma) in the first 30 days postpartum
Incidence of wound composite outcome at all visits (till four months)
Evaluation of microbial deposits on sutures
cohort: 124 women (18-40 years) with a singleton pregnancy requiring cesarean delivery at two different centers across India
finding: There was no significant difference in the incidence of wound composite outcomes between Monoglyde® and Monocryl® poliglecaprone-25 sutures for subcuticular skin closure following cesarean delivery.
